issues.description: Reviews two-column layout used an inline gridTemplateColumns style that overrode responsive stacking, crushing All Reviews and Audit History into two narrow colliding columns on mobile.
issues.rootCause: Inline style={{ gridTemplateColumns: 'minmax(0, 1.4fr) minmax(0, 1fr)' }} took precedence over @media (max-width: 1020px) rules.
issues.fixApplied: Replaced inline grid style with .reviews-grid CSS class collapsing cleanly to 1fr at <= 1020px.
issues.verificationResult: Passed DOM overflow/overlap audit and visual review at 320px, 390px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px.

issues.description: Audit History rows squeezed actor name, raw action text (e.g. 'auth login', 'decision approved'), finding key, and timestamp onto one competing flex row, causing name wrapping, timestamp collisions, and poor hierarchy.
issues.rootCause: Single-row flex layout placed timestamp beside long free-flowing inline text with raw dot-separated action names.
issues.fixApplied: Built shared <AuditFeed /> with a 2-column avatar/content grid, wrapping actor+timestamp header row, human-readable verbs, non-breaking finding keys, and 2-line clamped context with full tooltip.
issues.verificationResult: 0 overlap/height/overflow findings across all 84 viewport x route x state checks.

issues.description: Long document titles and unbroken reference IDs overflowed cards at 320px/390px and bled across status pills and Open buttons in list rows.
issues.rootCause: Inline <Link> inside .dlist2 .dt lacked block display + min-width: 0 + overflow: hidden, and .dcont h2 lacked overflow-wrap: anywhere.
issues.fixApplied: Added min-width: 0 on cards/rows, .dt-link ellipsis truncation with full title tooltip, overflow-wrap: anywhere and 2-line clamp on .dcont h2.
issues.verificationResult: 0 horizontal overflow or clipped card findings even with 120+ character stress document titles.

issues.description: Account menu used fixed 280px width without viewport clamping on 320px mobile, lacked opening animation, did not support ArrowUp/ArrowDown navigation, and did not return focus to the avatar button on Escape.
issues.rootCause: Fixed pixel width and missing focus-return / arrow-key handler in AppShell.
issues.fixApplied: Added responsive min(268px, calc(100vw - 20px)) width, fixed mobile positioning, subtle menuPop animation, ArrowUp/ArrowDown navigation, and focus return to avatar trigger on Escape.
issues.verificationResult: Playwright verified menu stays inside viewport at 320px-1440px, closes on Escape & outside click, and restores focus to .avbtn.

issues.description: Mobile sidebar drawer slid over the header toggle button with no visible close button inside the drawer.
issues.rootCause: Drawer z-index (45) covered header (20) while .side-brand only rendered text without a close action.
issues.fixApplied: Added accessible Close navigation button inside .side-brand and returned focus to the sidebar toggle button on close.
issues.verificationResult: Verified drawer opens and closes via Close navigation button in Playwright at 390px.

issues.description: Mobile document rows showed a bare page count number ('4') with no label once table headers hid.
issues.rootCause: Table header row hidden below 760px without data-label prefixes on mobile rows.
issues.fixApplied: Added data-label='Pages' and data-label='Findings' with CSS ::before prefixes on mobile plus full-width responsive search toolbar.
issues.verificationResult: Verified cleanly labeled rows in after/documents-390.png.

issues.description: Format segmented control crowded narrow mobile widths and the export preview table stayed wide instead of stacking cleanly.
issues.rootCause: Long segment labels ('Markdown', 'PDF Report') and desktop table layout remained active on mobile.
issues.fixApplied: Shortened format labels to CSV/MD/JSON/PDF, made Download button full-width on mobile, and stacked table rows into readable mobile cards.
issues.verificationResult: 0 segmented control or table overflow findings at 320px and 390px.

issues.description: Floating bottom page/zoom dock extended across the gap into the findings lane at 768px tablet width.
issues.rootCause: Keyboard shortcut hints inside .dock remained visible down to 761px, pushing dock width past the PDF sheet.
issues.fixApplied: Hid .dock .dkeys below 960px so the page/zoom bar stays compact directly under the PDF column.

issues.description: Long 3-line document titles in Continue Reviewing pushed Recent Activity down enough to clip the 5th activity item on 900px desktop viewports.
issues.rootCause: Unclamped heading height in row 1 combined with 5 activity rows inside fixed-height desktop dashboard.
issues.fixApplied: Clamped .dcont h2 to 2 lines (full title on tooltip) and displayed 4 cleanly spaced AuditFeed items in the non-scrolling desktop card.
issues.verificationResult: All 4 recent activity rows render completely with zero clipping and zero page scroll.

issues.description: Visual review of first after-pass caught the 40px circular avatar inside .um-me stretching horizontally into an oval.
issues.rootCause: .um-me > span { flex: 1 } matched both <span class='av'> and the profile text wrapper <span>.
issues.fixApplied: Scoped rule to .um-me > span:not(.av) and added permanent 1:1 avatar aspect-ratio check to layout-audit.ts.
issues.verificationResult: Verified 40x40 circular avatar across all viewports with permanent regression guard.
